percent.title: 5% of every subscription
percent.body: You receive 5% of the plan value subscribed by anyone who joined through your referral.

recurring.title: Every month, not just the first
recurring.body: Participation is credited on each paid renewal, month after month, while the pet parent keeps the subscription active.

window.body: The count starts at the referred pet parent's first paid subscription and runs for 18 months. After that the subscription continues, but it no longer generates new participation.

payout.title: Withdraw from R$ 50.00

mover.mensagemPadrao: Hi! {paciente}'s appointment has been moved to {data} at {hora}. Just reply here if anything comes up.

encaixeDialogo.descricao: A squeeze-in sits outside the grid and is marked as such.

fechadaDialogo.descricao: The clinic is closed on {feriado}. Confirm twice so nobody books without noticing.
fechadaDialogo.primeiroPasso: I understand the clinic is closed

cancelarDialogo.descricao: The slot frees up, but the card stays visible on the day.
cancelarDialogo.aviso: The appointment for {paciente} was cancelled ({motivo}). Get in touch to rebook.

semana.semAlternativa: No free slots in the coming days.

criar.semVagaDescricao: No alternative in this search. The owner can join the waiting list and be notified when one opens.

bloqueio.janelaInvalida: The end must come after the start.

meuDia.esperandoVazio: Nobody waiting at the front desk.
meuDia.alertasVazio: No clinical alerts among today's patients.

resumo.semProntuario: No records completed in this period.

indicador.ocupacaoDetalhe: Average across days the clinic was open

grafico.porDiaAjuda: Columns add up the visits; the line tracks schedule occupancy.
grafico.horariosAjuda: How many visits start in each hour slot.

bulario.buscaPlaceholder: Search by drug, active ingredient or indication
bulario.escolha: Pick a medication from the list.
bulario.temAviso: Has a warning for this patient
bulario.proibidoRodape: Contraindicated for the species of this patient.
bulario.isencao: Decision-support content. It does not replace the manufacturer leaflet or the judgement of the responsible veterinarian.

aviso.sem-dose-da-especie: No species-specific dose in the formulary.

cuidado.gestante: Pregnant patient — this active ingredient needs caution.
cuidado.lactante: Nursing patient — this active ingredient needs caution.
cuidado.filhote: Young patient — this active ingredient needs caution.
cuidado.idoso: Senior patient — this active ingredient needs caution.

documentos.ajuda: Each document prints as an A4 sheet, ready to print or save as PDF.
documentos.notaImpressao: The print dialog opens with the sheet; pick "Save as PDF" as the destination to send it to the owner.
documentos.passoComReceita: Review and issue prescription, certificate or record
documentos.passoSemReceita: Review and issue certificate or record

cartao.receituarioControle: Printed on a separate sheet, in duplicate
cartao.semPrescricao: No medication prescribed in this visit

prontuario.descricao: History, physical exam, diagnosis and care plan.

receituario.descricao: Medications with spelled-out dosing and the amount to dispense.

atestado-saude.descricao: States that the animal was examined and what was found.

atestado-comparecimento.descricao: Justifies the owner absence during the visit.

pedido-exame.descricao: Sent to the lab with the clinical indication.

orientacoes.descricao: The sheet the owner takes home.

encaminhamento.descricao: Referral letter with the case summary.

atestado-viagem.descricao: Requires rabies vaccine and deworming up to date.

comprovante-vacinacao.descricao: Batch and manufacturer not yet recorded.

termo-consentimento.descricao: Signed by the owner before the procedure.

termo-recusa.descricao: Records that the advised treatment was declined.

orcamento.descricao: Amounts filled in by the clinic.

receita.semPrescricao: No medication prescribed in this visit.
receita.avisoControle: Controlled-substance prescription in duplicate, per applicable regulation.

atestado.rodape: Issued at the owner request, for whatever purposes may be needed.

saude.corpoComDiagnostico: I certify that on {data} I examined the animal {paciente}, identified above, and found: {diagnostico}.
saude.corpoSemAchado: I certify that on {data} I examined the animal {paciente}, identified above, and found no clinical abnormality in the examination performed.

comparecimento.corpo: I certify that {responsavel} was at this clinic on {data}, from {entrada} to {saida}, accompanying the animal {paciente} during veterinary care.

viagem.corpo: I certify that the animal {paciente}, species {especie}, was examined on this date ({data}) and showed no clinical signs of infectious disease, being fit for transport.

pedidoExame.jejum: Fast for 8 to 12 hours for laboratory tests. Water is allowed.
pedidoExame.vazio: No tests requested in this consultation.

orientacoes.retornoEm: Return in {dias} days, or sooner if the condition worsens.
orientacoes.procureTitulo: Contact the clinic before the follow-up if you notice
orientacoes.procureTexto: Refusal to eat for more than 24 h, persistent vomiting or diarrhoea, marked lethargy, difficulty breathing, bleeding, seizure, or any worsening of the condition that prompted this visit.

encaminhamento.paraDica: Name and speciality of the receiving professional or service
encaminhamento.disponivel: Full medical record available to the colleague on request and with the owner’s authorisation.

termo.objetoIndefinido: the procedure indicated on this date

consentimento.declaracao: I, {responsavel}, responsible for the animal {paciente}, declare that I have been clearly informed about the procedure indicated for {objeto}, including its expected benefits, the risks involved and the available alternatives. I authorise the clinic’s team to carry it out.
consentimento.itens: Any procedure under anaesthesia carries risk, even when the patient is stable and pre-operative tests are normal.|Unforeseen complications may occur, requiring a change of approach during the procedure.|Additional unplanned procedures may be necessary to preserve the animal’s life.|No outcome has been guaranteed; the commitment is one of means, not of result.
consentimento.ciencia: I declare that I have read this form, that my questions were answered, and that I authorise the procedure freely and with full information.

recusa.declaracao: I, {responsavel}, responsible for the animal {paciente}, declare that I have been informed of the treatment recommended by the veterinarian for {objeto}, and that, by my own decision, I DO NOT authorise it.
recusa.itens: Refusing the recommended treatment may worsen the animal’s condition.|Refusal may lead to avoidable suffering and, in some cases, to death.|Responsibility for the consequences of this decision is entirely mine.|I may reconsider this decision at any time and return to the clinic.
recusa.ciencia: I declare that this refusal is my own decision, taken after being informed, and I release the clinic’s team from its consequences.

eutanasia.carimbo: Authorisation document — requires the owner’s signature
eutanasia.declaracao: I, {responsavel}, responsible for the animal {paciente}, declare that I have been informed about the clinical condition of {objeto}, about the prognosis presented and about the treatment and palliative care alternatives, and I authorise euthanasia.
eutanasia.itensTitulo: I declare that I understand that
eutanasia.itens: Euthanasia is an irreversible act.|I was informed of the available alternatives, including palliative care.|The decision was made by me, without coercion, after being informed.|I am the legal guardian of the animal identified in this document.
eutanasia.ciencia: I declare, under my responsibility, that I am the lawful guardian of the animal identified here and I authorise the procedure.

obito.declaracao: I certify that the animal {paciente}, species {especie}, breed {raca}, sex {sexo}, aged {idade}, belonging to {responsavel}, has died as recorded below.
obito.semNecropsia: Probable cause, established by clinical assessment. No necropsy was performed.

vacinacao.declaracao: I certify that the animal {paciente} received the vaccines listed below at this clinic.
vacinacao.ressalva: Batch, manufacturer and booster date must be checked against the animal’s vaccination card. Without those fields completed, this document does not replace the card for travel purposes.

orcamento.carimbo: Estimate — not an authorisation to proceed
orcamento.validade: Estimate valid for 15 days from the date of issue.
orcamento.ressalva: Estimated amounts. Additional procedures identified during care will be reported before being carried out.

fila.vazioDescricao: When no slot fits, add the patient here instead of improvising.

vagaAberta.descricao: {hora} with {profissional} is free. These patients fit that window.
vagaAberta.ninguem: Nobody on the list fits this window.

oferta.prazo: The offer expires in {minutos} minutes. After that, the slot returns to the clinic.
oferta.mensagemPadrao: Hello! A slot opened up for {paciente} on {data} at {hora}. Shall we confirm? We will hold it for {minutos} minutes.

faltas.vazioDescricao: Good sign: nobody missed an appointment in the period.
faltas.totalMinutos: {valor} of idle schedule in the period

politica.descricao: From {limite} no-shows the system suggests asking for confirmation before holding the slot. It is a suggestion: the clinic decides, case by case.

reagendar.mensagemPadrao: Hello! We missed {paciente} today. We have a new slot on {data} at {hora} — shall we confirm?

prontuario.vazioDescricao: Records show up here as appointments are completed.
prontuario.somenteLeitura: Being edited on {dispositivo} since {desde}. You are in read-only.

assumirDialogo.descricao: Another device has this record open. Taking over puts it in read-only and lets you compare field by field.

anamnese.descricao: What brought the patient in and what the pet parent noticed.

exameFisico.descricao: Values are checked against the species range as you type.

conduta.descricao: Guidance, prescription and what is agreed for later.
conduta.resumoDose: {quantidade} {unidade} ({mg} mg) every {frequencia} h for {duracao} days — {total} doses.
conduta.semPeso: Without the patient's weight the dose is not calculated.

avisoDose.peso-ausente: Record the weight in the physical exam to calculate the dose.

conduta.alergiaDescricao: This patient's record lists an allergy to {principio}. Prescribing is still possible, with explicit confirmation.
conduta.alergiaConfirmar: I confirm and want to prescribe anyway

retornoDialogo.descricao: Free slots with the same professional, from the date suggested in the care plan.

fracao.um-e-meio: One and a half tablets per dose
fracao.quarto: A quarter of a tablet per dose
fracao.tres-quartos: Three quarters of a tablet per dose
fracao.arredondado: the calculation gave {calculado}; confirm the rounding

timeline.vazio: This patient has no recorded history yet.

finalizarDialogo.descricao: Once completed, the record no longer accepts direct editing.

impressao.dica: Opens the browser print dialog — choose "Save as PDF" as the destination.
impressao.semRegistro: No vital signs recorded in this visit.

resumo.descricao: Check what was recorded before issuing the documents.
resumo.alergiaPendente: Prescription of {medicamento} conflicts with a recorded allergy and was not accepted.

preConsulta.pesoInformado: Weight reported at home: {valor} — confirm on the scale

pacientes.buscar: Search by patient, pet parent or phone
pacientes.vazioDescricao: Adjust the search or register the patient at the front desk.

atividades.vazioDescricao: Draft records and follow-ups without a slot show up here.

atalhos.mover: Move the focused appointment by 15 min

comandos.dica: Type / to insert a ready-made snippet

painel.descricao: Non-production only. Drives the mock layer without reloading the page.

design.descricao: The five base components in the four states, with live density. This is the module ruler: a component that fails here does not reach the schedule or the record.
design.nomesExtremosDescricao: A two-letter name, a very long name and dense accents, side by side. If the header breaks, it breaks here first.
design.cansacoDescricao: Two hundred rows in the chosen density. Enough to judge whether the table tires you out before the shift ends.
design.escalaDeCinzaDescricao: No information may be lost without color. Every state carries an icon, a label or a shape beyond the hue.
design.feedback: Feedback from someone who runs a clinic
design.feedbackVazio: No review recorded yet. Note here what the clinical team pointed out, with date and name.

avisos.vazio: No notice sent for this appointment.

cronometro.esquecidaTitulo: This timer has been running for a long time
cronometro.esquecidaDescricao: It has been running for over four hours. If it was left open by mistake, discard it: stopping would record the time as worked.
cronometro.comoFunciona: Time is rounded up to the next unit. The real elapsed time always stays visible next to it.
